# e57view

Browser viewer for E57 / PLY / LAS point clouds. Humans open a scan; agents drive it.

## Open a scan (no MCP)

https://opensketch.web.app/?cloud=CLOUD_ID
https://opensketch.web.app/?cloud=CLOUD_ID&view=top
https://opensketch.web.app/?cloud=CLOUD_ID&view=fit&ai=heuristic&kinds=noise

Query args: cloud, view (fit|top), az, el, dist, ai (heuristic|openai|xai), kinds (comma list: veg,vehicle,people,noise), session, agent=1 (local MCP bridge).

## Drive without configuring MCP

1. In the viewer, Agent → Copy agent URL (or open the scan with ?session=SESSION). Keep that tab open.
2. POST https://opensketch.web.app/agent
   Content-Type: application/json

{"session":"SESSION","cmd":"state"}
{"session":"SESSION","cmd":"screenshot","args":{"width":1024}}
{"session":"SESSION","cmd":"set_view","args":{"preset":"top"}}
{"session":"SESSION","cmd":"ai_suggest","args":{"provider":"heuristic","kinds":["noise"]}}
{"session":"SESSION","cmd":"suggestions","args":{"op":"apply"}}
{"session":"SESSION","cmd":"history","args":{"op":"undo"}}

GET https://opensketch.web.app/agent  — command list
GET https://opensketch.web.app/agent?s=SESSION  — is the tab online?

Responses include result JSON and, for most cmds, shot (JPEG base64). The original file on disk is never overwritten.

## Local MCP (same machine as the tab)

claude mcp add e57view -- node /path/to/e57view/mcp/server.mjs
Then open the viewer with ?agent=1
